title: Require Service Effect Error Authority
forbids: an explicit global Error type or same-source subclass of global Error in an Effect failure channel in production standalone service source or embedded API-plugin service source
why: Each fallible service capability owns the exact typed failure crossing its boundary. A sole owning port declares that failure beside itself; multiple sibling ports sharing one capability failure use module-local model/errors. Adapters translate foreign failures once, and procedures map those failures through contract-declared errors instead of widening service failure channels to the unqualified global Error type.
remediate: Define a Data.TaggedError beside the sole owning port, store, or shared module error owner. Use it in the capability's Effect channel. Reserve Schema.TaggedErrorClass for a separately serialized boundary. Translate foreign failures once at the owning adapter or store, and map capability failures through the procedure handler's errors.* constructors.
message: Service Effect failure channels do not admit global Error or a same-source Error subclass.
